summaryZh: Firtel 实验室研究控制真核细胞趋化运动和形态发生的信号转导与力学机制。团队以盘基网柄菌为主要模型，结合遗传、生物化学方法和活细胞 GFP 融合蛋白实时分析，探索细胞如何感知方向信号并改变细胞骨架。
researchQuestions: 哪些分子机制调控使细胞能够趋化的信号通路？
信号通路与细胞骨架重组如何共同控制细胞运动？
methods: GFP 融合蛋白活细胞实时分析

evidence.quote: Our laboratory focuses on the signal transduction pathways and the mechanics that control directional cell movement, or chemotaxis, and morphogenesis of eukaryotic cells.

we use Dictyostelium as our primary experimental system, which allows us to employ a wide range of genetic as well as biochemical approaches to dissect these signaling pathways. These methods are combined with in vivo, real-time analysis of GFP fusions of signaling proteins in living cells
Our goal is to reveal the molecular mechanisms regulating these and other signaling pathways that enable cells to chemotax.
A major unanswered question in cell motility is how the signaling pathways and the reorganizations of the cytoskeleton function together to control cell movement.
